title: MividMC Edit
description: A small modification preserving the vanilla aspects of Minecraft focused on PVP.
body:
# Changes
This pack changes a few aspects of PvP, which are:
- Smaller fire
- Smaller totems when used
- Smaller shield
- Changed textures for the end crystal and ender pearl
- And some minor changes to various textures.
